environment.note: Execution gas of direct calls. Governor transactions are lower bounds: a Safe adds execTransaction and signature verification, not measured here.

l1.note: Read-only snapshot of public chain parameters. l1GasUsed depends only on the transaction bytes; the fees depend on L1 and L2 prices at each block and change over time. Priority fees are excluded.

calibration.method: getL1GasUsed(unsigned serialization) at the transaction's block, against the receipt's l1GasUsed
